approval.quote: So I really, really like this design.
approval.scope: Quick sheet variant with OpenAI and Claude model marks and the existing OpenShell mark in Run on.

invariants: One Chat settings sheet opened from the chat header; composer remains separate.
Quiet neutral header and rows; no tinted form groups or permanently expanded editors.
One field editor at a time with Back; Escape leaves an editor before closing the sheet.
Visual and keyboard row order agree; mobile targets are at least 44px.
OpenAI and Claude marks identify their models; existing OpenShell mark accompanies Run on.
Preserve all account, model, thinking, agent, execution, repository, permissions, web, voice, session and default actions, including unavailable and locked states.
Opening, closing and navigating retain editor state and composer drafts.
Shared theme, accent, font, motion and reduced-motion preferences remain effective.

approval.quote: Fine. That works. Implement this and only this.
approval.scope: Replace the binary priority affordance with a 1–10 selector in the existing item header and show the selected value as a compact P<n> badge in the existing Work tree. Preserve the rest of the approved Telos interface.

invariants: Priority is an integer from 1 to 10, with larger numbers displayed as higher priority.
The item header contains one labelled Priority selector showing the selected value out of 10.
The existing Work tree shows the same value as a compact P<n> badge.
The surrounding Telos layout, navigation, content and controls remain unchanged.
The priority amendment preserves existing grouping, urgency sorting and navigation.

approval.quote: Looks decent. Let’s update telos and give a handover to start
approval.scope: Fresh ordinary agent setup, reviewed joining brief, compact participant header, one Agents view and shared composer. Existing-chat import removed; Fork remains separate. Canonical Telos approval d2b5bce4090c39a595457335763271b5 revision 1.

invariants: Ordinary chat first, compact participant header, one Agents dialog and the existing shared composer with stable recipient attribution.
Add agent is fresh editable setup with Agent, name, Account/Model/Thinking, Mac host then OpenShell runtime choices, real repository and full or selected starting context.
Add agent retains Cancel and Fresh session · starts with a prompt. in its reachable footer; returning to Agents preserves the editable draft.

Before joining retains Back/title/close, separate boot guidance, exact attributed context and saved artifact filenames/versions, editable refrozen brief on the same screen, flat Agents policy row, and Back / Join conversation.
No extra Freeze step, existing-chat import, cross-group enrollment or substitute recipient form; Fork remains separate.
Setup, review, joining and reading alone invoke no model; unavailable authority, stale review and uncertain recovery retain editable intent or original join identity.
Shared tokens, components, native actions, focus restoration and motion preferences remain effective; body scrolls independently while footer stays reachable.
